rebelytics-one-skill-to-rule-them-all-ta.description: Turns corrections, repeated workflows and judgement calls from work sessions into small, evidenced skill updates: logs each observation with its source, stages every change for your approval, and flags repeating work as new skills. Use during ANY multi-step task, agentic workflow, or work session. Also triggers in post-task feedback discussions and when the user mentions skill observations, the observation log, or skill taxonomy.
